origin.description: Draw strings of the requested lengths from a character class.

arguments.name: n
arguments.text: How many strings to draw. A negative value yields an empty vector.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.text: A UnicodeSet character class. Recycled to n.

origin.details: Each code point is drawn with equal probability. A missing length or pattern makes that string missing. The generator is not shared with other software.
origin.example: x <- stri_rand_strings(4, 5, "[a-z]"); cat(paste0("stri_rand_strings(4, 5, \"[a-z]\") returns ", length(x), " strings of length ", paste(nchar(x), collapse = ", "), ".\n"))

translation.description: Draw strings of the requested lengths from a character class.

arguments.name: n
arguments.text: How many strings to draw. A negative value yields an empty vector.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.text: A UnicodeSet character class. Recycled to n.

translation.details: Sampling uses Python's random generator and an ICU UnicodeSet. It does not share a stream with R. A missing length or pattern yields NA. n < 0 yields an empty list.
translation.value: A list of strings. A missing element is NA.
translation.example:
x = stri_rand_strings(4, 5, "[a-z]")
lengths = ", ".join(str(len(item)) for item in x)
print(f"stri_rand_strings(4, 5, '[a-z]') returns {len(x)} strings of length {lengths}.")
